notes:
Account profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app guidance). Product team owned POC; Platform/Infra (CTO + Head of Infra) reviewing Dedicated constraints. Wanted quick time-to-value so started on Hosted API trial (4 weeks).

Hosted trial summary (concise):
- Trial window: 2025-11-21 -> 2025-12-19. Used hosted endpoints for chat + embeddings + some reranking.
- Traffic pattern observed (trial samples): avg QPS 12, peak burst QPS 65 (during batch experiments). Average concurrency observed ~28.
- Token mix during trial: avg tokens/request ~380 (prompt ~= 140, completion ~= 240). Embeddings jobs were 18% of calls but accounted for ~35% of tokens.
- Latency (hosted): chat p50 85ms, p95 420ms (varies by model); embeddings p50 110ms.
- Cost run-rate (hosted experimental): ~$9k/month at trial velocity. Team reported good quality on Gemini-like open models; want lower and predictable unit cost.

Business interest & production targets:
- Target production (12-month horizon): sustained QPS 80, peak QPS 200 (short spikes), concurrency target ~120 under typical backpressure.
- Expected request profile: 62% chat/assistant (streaming favored), 25% embeddings for search/rerank, 13% batch summarization.
- Average tokens/request projected: 450 (prompt ~150, completion ~300). Streaming expected on ~60% of chat calls.
- Latency SLOs: p50 <100ms for assistant responses (streaming start), p95 <600ms acceptable for heavy contexts.

Dedicated sizing ask (what they want from Redwood):
- Firm GPU sizing and pricing for reserved capacity to hit sustained 80 QPS with headroom for 200 QPS peaks. Guidance on autoscale/burst lanes and cost tradeoffs.
- VPC(private control plane) + KMS integration + SOC2 evidence + audit log retention 1 year. Data residency: US-only for some customers; need region pinning.
- Routing/fallback: want ability to fallback to Hosted API in outage and automated model variant routing to cheaper quantized variants for low-cost queries.

SE notes / Redwood preliminary sizing (from POC analysis):
- Based on request profile (avg 450 tokens) and concurrency goals, baseline Dedicated cluster estimate: 4 x A100-80GB (or 2 x H100-80GB equivalents) to support ~80 sustained QPS with ~120 concurrency on optimized kernels and batching.
- For safe peak headroom to 200 QPS with spikes: autoscale target to 6-8 A100 equiv or reserved pool with burst credits. Recommend enable prefix/KV caching for dialogs to cut token load ~12-18%.
- Embeddings worker pool: separate CPU+GPU pool recommended (2x A10/RTX-like nodes) to keep embedding latency predictable and avoid impacting chat throughput.

POC findings & technical risks:
- Positive: quantized variants preserved quality on 70% of user prompts; batching reduced per-token cost ~22% in trials.
- Risk: long-context (>4k tokens) cases push memory; plan to offload long-context to a specialized worker or increase KV cache capacity per replica.
- Security: customer will require answers to 120-question security questionnaire (in drive link). Pending.

Sales/Commercial notes:
- Pricing sensitivity: prefer committed monthly capacity with clear burst pricing; team asked for a blended cost per 1M tokens and a sample cost model for their projected 12-month growth.
- They are evaluating Redwood vs OpenAI + self-hosted GPU path. Differentiator: Redwood's unified runtime + VPC was attractive.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver Dedicated sizing doc (detailed GPUs, node types, autoscale policy) + committed pricing options (monthly tiers + burst). Owner: SE (Liam). Due: 2026-03-17.
- Schedule infra deep-dive (2h) with CTO + infra (provision architecture diagram + network/VPC requirements). Target week of 2026-03-22.
- Complete security questionnaire responses and SOC2 artifacts (Sofia to follow up).

Quotes / direct snippets captured:
- "We like quality but need predictable unit cost — spikes kill our margin." (Head of Product)
- "If we can pin region + get volume discount, we can commit 12 months." (CTO)
